package.name: base101_lidar
package.description: RPLidar C1 driver + self-filter for base101. Wraps rplidar_ros with the base101-specific serial port/baud/frame defaults and a laser_filters chain that blanks the angular sector where base101's own payload deck (standoffs, Jetson/link101 mounts) sits in the scan plane — see config/lidar_filters.yaml for the geometry this is derived from.
